project: Namias Portfolio - Codebase Cleanup & README Revamp
summary: Clean up the repository root by removing stale planning documents, legacy config files, and working artifacts that no longer serve the active codebase. Revamp the README to use Sanity-hosted image URLs (replacing broken local file references) and present a cleaner, more professional first impression for visitors and contributors.
narrative: Over the course of development, the repository root accumulated several planning documents, agent prompts, and working notes (SANITY_*.md, CMS_*.md, progress.txt) that served their purpose during feature development but now clutter the project root. Additionally, a legacy .eslintrc.json file conflicts with the new eslint.config.mjs flat config. The README.md references local file paths (./public/images/profile/PP%20Namias.png, ./public/resume.pdf) that no longer exist since all media has been migrated to Sanity CMS. This PRD plans a clean sweep: remove stale files, upgrade the README to pull images directly from the Sanity CDN, and modernize the project presentation.
principles: Remove what is unused — every file at the root should serve an active purpose.
One config standard — ESLint flat config (eslint.config.mjs) replaces legacy .eslintrc.json.
All production media comes from Sanity — README images must use Sanity CDN URLs, not local paths.
Professional presentation — the README is the first thing visitors see; it must be clean, accurate, and well-structured.
Verification — every change must pass lint, type-check, and test gates.
Each logical change is a commit — removal, README revamp, and verification each get their own commit.
